tool_args.rationale: The five pilot rows stop at H=0.48. The slow-horizon probe measures near H=20, close to the target H=21.1, where continued positive gain and adaptation-driven reversal can be distinguished.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: At short horizons, adaptation amplitude and slow time constant mainly enter as a ratio. A good pilot fit can still give the wrong sign or magnitude at H=21.1.
Finer trajectory sampling is less directly informative about slow adaptation than a measurement near the forecast horizon.
It does not distinguish the competing long-horizon predictions.
